audited_plan.image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a glass dessert dish containing scoops of white ice cream topped with a generous amount of dark, glossy chocolate sauce. The sauce is thick and viscous, draping over the ice cream and pooling slightly at the bottom. A silver spoon rests in the dish on the left side, partially submerged in the sauce and ice cream. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the smooth surface of the chocolate sauce.

AI generators often struggle with the phase change boundary where a warm/room-temp liquid meets a frozen solid. Look for 'muddying' or lack of distinct separation.
